screens.title: An exploded-view technical illustration of a furniture joint. Heavy-duty steel interlocking snap brackets and precision CNC-cut light oak wood pieces coming together. No screws or tools visible. The visual shows the "CLICK" moment of the snap joinery. Minimalist, architectural style, warm lighting, very high detail.

A split-screen composition for a high-end furniture brand. Left side: 6 neat, minimalist flat cardboard boxes stacked against a warm porcelain wall. Right side: A stunning, sun-drenched Japandi living room and bedroom featuring a modular terracotta-colored sofa, a warm oak flat-pack coffee table, and a minimalist bed frame. The transition between the boxes and the room feels magical and seamless. Professional interior photography, soft natural lighting, tactile textures.
MODULIV — Free Swatch Box & Material Discovery

A premium fabric swatch box for MODULIV. A small, beautifully designed cardboard box open to reveal several textured fabric swatches in neutral and terracotta tones, with a $50 voucher card resting on top. Placed on a light wood surface with soft shadows. Warm minimalist aesthetic.

A high-end, close-up editorial shot of an open minimalist kraft paper box from MODULIV. Inside the box are several neatly arranged, highly tactile upholstery swatches (Cream Bouclé, Caramel Corduroy, Olive Velvet, Tech Leather), two small squares of high-density white foam, and two small polished wood chips (Oak and Walnut). Resting on top is a sleek matte black $50 voucher card with the MODULIV logo in gold. Soft, warm natural sunlight creates gentle shadows. Minimalist Japandi aesthetic.
